cohort: 240 women with singleton pregnancies complicated by preterm premature rupture of membranes (P-PROM) delivering at 24-37 weeks
finding: Vaginal infection, previous cesarean section, primiparity, gravidity > 5, university education, and prenatal care were identified as predictors of Caesarean Section in P-PROM.
mod_finding: This study identified several predictors of Cesarean section in preterm premature rupture of membranes, including previous cesarean section, primiparity, gravidity > 5, and prenatal care.
